description: Real high-performing Twitter hooks for AI training. Focus: Contrarian, Data Reveal, Transformation patterns.
source: Bird CLI competitive data + 2026 viral tweet research + linkedgraphix validation

voice_requirements.structure: Short lines with white space, use → arrows and bullets

anti_patterns.hook: Free 10-35 hours weekly with a 24/7 AI employee, not just saving minutes

anti_patterns.hook: Most people think AI automation saves minutes
anti_patterns.why_it_fails: AI cliché ('Most people think'), Vague claim, Formulaic opening

anti_patterns.hook: Kip Bodnar built an AI app live that extracts 16 viral talking points from a 30-minute YouTube video in under 10 minutes.
anti_patterns.why_it_fails: Third-person reporter (not first-person witness), Too much info crammed in, No emotional hook, Feels like press release
